title: Unclench
intro: A small tour of places that often tighten while we work. Soften what you can and skip what you cannot.

steps.text: Let your jaw soften. Teeth slightly apart, tongue resting.
Let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
Open your hands and let your fingers lie loose.
Smooth your forehead and let your eyes be soft.
Take one easy breath and notice if anything else wants to soften.

closing: That is the tour. Carry on whenever you are ready.
